messages:
emily_ae: Heads-up StratusEdge POC stalled. Two asks came up in today's call: EU-only telemetry/logs and a requested committed-throughput discount to match a competing quote. They want exec visibility if we can't move by EOD.

raj_sales: Bleh. Do we know the exact discount percent they're pushing for?

diego_eng: They requested ~18% off our standard committed throughput tiers and explicit guarantee that telemetry + model logs never leave EU.

nina_cloudops: We can run the POC inside our eu-west-1 private tenancy. Provisioning a scoped cluster takes ~36 hours normally. For a rapid unblock we can do a temporary tenant using existing infra but need billing sign-off and legal

sophie_product: For pricing we have three levers: longer term commit, reserved capacity, or lower-performance quantized SKU. Could we offer a short-term promotional committed rate for their POC that escalates to normal pricing at renewal?

ben_legal: I can draft a POC addendum limiting data residency and audit access. Need confirmation on retention window and whether they require KMS keys controlled by them.

emily_ae: They want 60-90 day retention, KMS in their tenant (preferred) but will accept our KMS if we provide keywrap and signed attestation.

diego_eng: Technical note: we can point model runtime + cache + telemetry to EU buckets and disable cross-region shipping. KMS-handshake with customer keys will take an ops ticket but is doable.

nina_cloudops: Action: opening expedited ticket #TENANT-991 for temporary EU tenant and key provisioning. ETA: 24h if billing & legal sign-off.

raj_sales: @cecilia_vp can you approve a short-term spend (~\u20AC3.2k) to stand up the tenant so we can demo?

cecilia_vp: Approve conditional on a 1-pager ROI: expected ARR and probability of conversion. Need it in 30m.

sophie_product: I'll create a concise ROI slide: ARR assumptions, sensitivity to discount, and production migration path (quantized SKU + autoscale).

ben_legal: Drafting addendum now and will label it "POC-only residency". Will include KMS options and SOC2 artifact access clause. Link when ready.

emily_ae: Customer requested exec sync at 16:00 CET. If infra isn't ready we should do a triage with their CTO and offer a live technical readout + timeline.

diego_eng: For the triage we can demo a local run and show our routing diagram: EU runtime path, KV cache isolation, telemetry toggle. That should reassure them.

ops-bot: Ticket TENANT-991 created by nina_cloudops. Priority: high. Estimated provisioning: 2025-11-05T12:30:00Z (accelerated).

raj_sales: I'll set expectations: triage at 16:00 CET; demo pending infra readiness at 18:00 CET. Asking customer if they'd accept that cadence.

cecilia_vp: Approving spend. @sophie_product and @emily_ae get me the 1-pager and customer ARR math ASAP.

sophie_product: Posted ROI one-pager: https://redwood.docs/stratusedge-poc-roi-v1 (includes three pricing paths and conversion scenarios).

ben_legal: Addendum link: https://redwood.share/stratusedge-poc-residency-draft (comments enabled). Please review before I send to customer.

emily_ae: Sending calendar invites: triage @16:00 CET with StratusEdge CTO + their security lead. Demo placeholder @18:00 CET. Attendees: Raj, Diego, Nina, Sophie, Ben, Cecilia.

raj_sales: On the pricing front, I'll offer an "introductory POC rate" that matches halfway to their competitor request for the POC only, with a clear note that production pricing will be finalized during contract stage.

diego_eng: Small tech ask: ensure we do not enable any telemetry exporters by default in the provisioned tenant. We'll supply a sanitized logs view for SOC2 checks.

nina_cloudops: Confirmed. Provisioning will disable exporters and set region-only retention. KMS handshake ticket created under TENANT-991-KMS.

ops-bot: TENANT-991 updated: KMS ticket attached TENANT-991-KMS. Current status: provisioning in progress.

ben_legal: Sending the POC addendum to StratusEdge legal with markup. If they sign today, we can keep the demo timeline.

emily_ae: Customer replied: they want the POC addendum by EOD and prefer the demo at 18:00 CET. They also asked for a short SLA for the POC window.

cecilia_vp: If they sign the addendum today, we absorb the one-time tenant cost. We should get the commitment signal during the demo.

sophie_product: I'll prepare a short SLA snippet for the POC (uptime commitment, support response window, and rollback plan).

raj_sales: Great work team. I'll run the triage at 16:00 and prioritize the 18:00 demo if infra completes. Will post notes after triage. :thumbsup:
